notes: §1985:IX.2.3.2 prints the indexed file control entry: SELECT [OPTIONAL] file-name-1, ASSIGN TO {implementor-name-1 | literal-1} ..., [RESERVE integer-1 [AREA | AREAS]], [ORGANIZATION IS] INDEXED, [ACCESS MODE IS {SEQUENTIAL | RANDOM | DYNAMIC}], RECORD KEY IS data-name-1, [ALTERNATE RECORD KEY ...] ..., [FILE STATUS IS data-name-3]. PARTIAL: every element of the format is implemented at 85, and one clause outside it is accepted. Implemented (read and probed at 85): fileControlClauseGroup and fileControlClauses parse every clause in any order with each optional word (TO, IS, MODE, KEY, FILE, WITH, AREA/AREAS) omitted or written, and BindFileControl captures them; Screen over RequiredClauses refuses an entry without ASSIGN or an indexed entry without RECORD KEY (COBOL5701, the witness); ScreenClauseRepetition refuses a second ASSIGN, ORGANIZATION, ACCESS MODE, RECORD KEY, RESERVE or FILE STATUS clause (COBOL2423); VisitUnrecognizedClause refuses a word that opens no clause (COBOL1970); the clauses 2023 adds are refused by their gates (ASSIGN USING, SOURCE keys, SUPPRESS WHEN, COLLATING SEQUENCE, LOCK MODE, SHARING, all COBOL0900); the EntryClauses rows refuse the other formats' clauses on an indexed file (RELATIVE KEY COBOL0863, RECORD DELIMITER COBOL2912). Not implemented: PADDING CHARACTER, which 1985 prints in the sequential entry only (§1985:VII.2.3.2). paddingCharacterClause is an alternative of fileControlClauses for every organization, BindFileControl has no arm for it and EntryClauses has no row for it (the table is cut on the 2023 formats, which have no such clause), so an indexed entry that writes it compiles clean at 85; the relative entry (§1985:VIII.2.3.2) accepts it the same way. The fix is the PB5070 mechanism's: capture the clause on the FileModel and give it a sequential-format row at the editions that have it. One determination, not a divergence: ASSIGN TO with two file-naming operands is refused with COBOL2256 under the implementor's rule for the operands (§1985:IX.2.3.3 SR3, docs/CONFORMANCE.md DOC-A.1-71); one operand, or DISK or PRINTER and one operand, is accepted.

next.reason: 1985 indexed file control entry: SELECT [OPTIONAL] file-name-1 ASSIGN TO implementor-name/literal, [RESERVE], [ORGANIZATION IS] INDEXED, [ACCESS MODE], RECORD KEY, [ALTERNATE RECORD KEY … [WITH DUPLICATES]], [FILE STATUS]. §2023:12.4.5.1 Format 1 and the clause formats that restate its parts (§2023:12.4.5.5.1 ACCESS MODE, §2023:12.4.5.6.2 ALTERNATE RECORD KEY, §2023:12.4.5.8.2 FILE STATUS, §2023:12.4.5.10.2 ORGANIZATION, §2023:12.4.5.12.2 RECORD KEY, §2023:12.4.5.14.2 RESERVE) keep every 1985 element and add ASSIGN USING, record-key-name SOURCE keys, SUPPRESS WHEN, collating-sequence-clause, LOCK MODE and SHARING. Clause order stays free after SELECT (§2023:12.4.5.2 SR1, the 2023 form of 1985 SR1, mapped there). Cases added at compile time; no refusal became an exception.
